create_skill_dataclass: create a Skill dataclass instance with name, description, category, and path metadata
get_skill_container_path: get the container path for a Skill instance mounted at a given base path
get_skill_container_file_path: get the full container file path to a Skill's SKILL.md file
get_skill_relative_path: get the relative path string from a Skill's category root to its directory
repr_skill_instance: get a readable string representation of a Skill instance with name, description, and category
